ocr.notes: Mostly right; a few prize amounts garbled ($75 heavyweight prize, $10 light-weight second prize, 1885 date)

title.suggested: Allen and Kelly to Spar at Union Club Tournament

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican listed the entries for the Union Club's Fourth of July tournament, closing with a sparring match for the Union Club cup between Tom Allen, ex-champion of the world, and Tom Kelly.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Thursday Morning, July 3, 1884 (Missouri Republican, not yet the St. Louis Republic)

facts.fact: Allen, billed as ex-champion of the world, was entered to spar Tom Kelly, ex-champion middleweight of the world, for the Union Club cup at the Union Club's Fourth of July tournament in St. Louis
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, St. Louis

notes: Allen was to wear his regular ring costume and the old colors. The article is a list of all tournament entries, so focus is secondary rather than primary. The venue comes from the companion ads (715-717); the clipped portion names only the Union club cup.
